title: The non-minimality degree of the type of a point outside the predicate is r minus one
author: John Baldwin, James Freitag, Scott Mutchnik
authors: John Baldwin, James Freitag, Scott Mutchnik
work: Simple Homogeneous Structures and Indiscernible Sequence Invariants
difficulty_reason: The theorem computes the non-minimality degree of a specific complete type: for the theory T_{r,k,mu} the type p given by the negation of the predicate P has nmdeg(p) = r - 1 (statement lines 2344-2351). The proof exhibits a tuple a_1, ..., a_r witnessing the relation R and analyses the successive types p_i = tp(a_i / A_{<i}): i-transitivity of the automorphism group on the complement of P makes each of the first r-1 a unique non-forking extension of p, while the last step forks because there are infinitely many choices of the final point producing distinct lines that meet the previous ones only in their common points (proof lines 2354-2368). The step that carries the content is the computation of the last step, since it is where the geometry of the lines is used to produce infinitely many forking extensions; the earlier steps are read off from the transitivity assumed in the construction. H2.
